meta.dataset: Simple offline irrigation planner reference map
meta.notes: Maps farmer-friendly crop growth stages to configured reference stages. Missing crop-stage values remain unavailable. Irrigation amounts require farmer-entered field capacity, wilting point, current volumetric moisture, effective root-zone depth, and configured crop depletion fraction. Published efficiency ranges produce a gross-application range, not a point value.

sources.label: FAO-56 crop coefficients, Table 12
sources.verificationStatus: FAO reference; crop-stage values retained only where configured

sources.label: FAO Irrigation Water Management crop factors, Chapter 3 Table 8
sources.parameter: Millet Kc stages and grouped Barley/Oats/Wheat stages
sources.verificationStatus: FAO reference; Barley/Wheat are grouped values, not crop-specific local calibration

sources.label: FAO-56 depletion fractions and root depths, Table 22
sources.parameter: Allowable depletion fraction p and crop root depth reference
sources.verificationStatus: FAO reference; farmer-entered effective root depth is still required

sources.label: FAO Soil and Water, typical soil water capacity, Table 8
sources.verificationStatus: Published typical classes; not substituted for measured field capacity or wilting point

sources.label: FAO AQUASTAT reference evapotranspiration normals
sources.verificationStatus: Verified reference dataset; historical normal, not live weather

sources.label: ICAR irrigation application efficiency ranges
sources.parameter: Method efficiency ranges for gross application interval
sources.verificationStatus: Published literature ranges; installed-system efficiency is not measured

meta.formula: ETc = ET0 × Kc; TAW = 1000 × (θFC − θWP) × root depth; Dr = 1000 × (θFC − θcurrent) × root depth; RAW = adjusted p × TAW; net refill is shown when Dr ≥ RAW; volume (litres) = depth (mm) × field area (m²); gross range divides by the published method efficiency bounds.
limitations: Historical district ETo climate normals are not today's weather or field rainfall observations.
Only manual or weather-station rainfall dated after the matching soil-moisture reading can be credited. Forecast/model rainfall and climate normals are never deducted.
Effective rainfall requires measured runoff/non-infiltration loss and measured root-zone storage; rain already reflected in the soil-moisture reading is excluded.
Rice/paddy dose is withheld because ponding, seepage, and percolation are not represented.
Field capacity, wilting point, current moisture, and current root depth must be entered from calibrated measurements; no typical value is substituted.
FAO-56 p adjustment assumes tabulated values near ETc 5 mm/day and is only a planning reference.
